# on-prem deployment -- generated by fde-framework

This project was emitted from an engagement profile. Every decision
in it is traced in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md); every risk
accepted along the way is in [RISKS.md](RISKS.md).

## Run the evaluation

```bash
python evals/harness.py --min-score 0.6
```

It fails until the pipeline is implemented end to end -- that is the
point. The scaffolded components under `app/components/` carry their
contracts; implement them by hand, or drive a coding agent against
the harness with `fde implement .` (the evals, the boundary and the
decision documents are fenced -- an agent that edits them is caught
and reverted).

## The pieces

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `app/pipeline.py` | The run order: payload steps, approval gates, critics |
| `app/contract.py` | RefusedInput -- forbidden input is refused, never guessed at |
| `evals/` | Golden / edge / adversarial sets from the client's own pairs, plus the acceptance protocol |
| `deploy/` | The substrate this profile earned, and how to tear it down |
| `ops/` | Runbook keyed to the failure taxonomy, SLOs, rollback |

Regenerating from the same facts reproduces this project byte for
byte; a diff between two builds means a decision changed.
